title: Broker-connectivity certification evidence requirements
authority_note: Evidence PLAN only. No evidence is collected by this artefact. Every certification run must emit a manifest conforming to the existing evidence schema. No secret or env-var VALUES anywhere.
principles: Machine-readable: capture in the manifest schema, not only prose.
Exact commands + actual results: record what happened, never a 'should pass'.
State limitations: every record lists what was not covered / skipped / assumed.
Checksums where integrity matters (images, manifests, backups).
PASS only when the applicable acceptance criteria actually ran; else PARTIAL/FAIL with reason.

requirements.capture: Disposable account/user list; demo classification; verify_image output; monitoring/log samples
requirements.retention: Life of certification + until the broader-beta decision

requirements.capture: Owner-scoping API responses; slot identity/dir/ACL read-backs; validation-isolation asserts; per-account credential audit
requirements.redaction: Redact host paths; masked last-4 only

requirements.capture: Lock-contention/lease/row-lock ordering; state_version series; claim-gate-under-load results
Refusal audits at creation/claim/dispatch; drift-guard output; route-coverage cross-check vs execution_entrypoints.json
get_contract series across the 6 states; threshold/convergence/state_version transcripts; no-auto-resume proof
Projected rows per source; dedup counts; visibility-scoped timeline/summary; recorder-failure logs; on_commit-discard-on-rollback
Per-workflow steps + expected UI + events + audit + operator actions
requirements.redaction: Customer-safe wording; no operator internals in customer-facing artefacts

requirements.capture: Injected fault -> expected fail-closed/fail-open state + events + rollback per case
Restart/retry/convergence continuity; no duplicate/ineligible action on resume
Flag/image/agent/validation-image rollback + disposable DB restore verification
Golden STOP-check before/after; CZ order-count = 0 throughout
No order placed against production during certification
CREDENTIAL_ACCESSED audit stream (redacted) matched to validation volume

what_must_never_be_included: Any secret or env-var VALUE (passwords, tokens, API keys, Fernet keys, keyring/envelope private keys, session strings)
Plaintext customer credentials in any field
Ciphertext, DPAPI blobs, accounts.dat, broker history/deals/orders/positions files
Customer Zero live credentials or any live-account credential
Bulk/raw data or binaries committed into Git
Cross-tenant data in any artefact (even operator artefacts)
Host paths / PIDs / IPC-TCP endpoints / raw exception strings in customer-facing artefacts
location: Repo-verifiable manifests -> evidence/manifests/*.json (+ evidence/ artefacts); bulk/host artefacts live OUTSIDE Git, referenced by location + checksum.
owner: Engineering owns repo-verifiable manifests + checksums; Operator owns host-collected evidence; Sponsor owns approvals + final sign-off.
